hero.description: Fresh Graduate in IT from President University who started development career in 2025. Focused on building digital solutions with clean and efficient code.

about.title: My Journey
about.subtitle: Fresh Graduate IT with Passion in Development
about.p1: I am a graduate of Information Technology from President University (Batch 2021-2024) who started my career as a developer in 2025. Although new to the industry, I have a strong determination to keep learning and growing.
about.p2: Currently, I am developing OrderApps SAS at PT. Sinergi Anugrah Services, an order management system application that is challenging and provides valuable experience in enterprise software development.

1.title: Started College
1.desc: Began studies at President University, Batch 2021. The scholarship I received made me enthusiastic and full of hope in starting my studies.

2.title: Graduated
2.desc: I spent three years studying programming, IoT, and game development. I've worked on several web-app projects, created IoT modules, and even completed my thesis capstone. I've completed my Information Technology degree

3.title: Start Development
3.desc: The first offer from a startup founded in 2021, emphasized that company development must also be supported by easy and efficient management. I had the opportunity to simplify manual workflows and launch my career as a developer.

exp.title: Development Career
exp.desc: Currently developing OrderApps SAS, an order management system application used to manage ordering processes and inventory lists, which will evolve into an ERP system for the company. Includes various features:

feature.1: Develop backend using PHP & Database management with MySQL
feature.2: Frontend integration with HTML, CSS, JavaScript
feature.3: CRUD features (Create, Read, Update, Delete), Approver, Generate PO, Generate PDF

projects.title: Current Project
projects.intro: As a developer who just started my career in 2025, I focus on developing OrderApps SAS. This project is my first experience in developing an enterprise-level application.
projects.desc: Order management system application for PT. Sinergi Anugrah Services. A system application used to manage ordering processes and inventory lists, which will evolve into an ERP system for the company.
